messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert fired: "hosted-inference-high-latency" (severity: P2) — multiple requests exceeding 2.5s threshold. Alert ID: PD-43321. Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-43321

ashley: acked the incident via mobile. I'm awake, looking now. Which region?

pagerduty: Escalation policy 'hosted-inference-slo' triggered secondary after 2m without ack (users: maya). PagerDuty note: secondary was paged.

maya: I didn't get the page, phone was DND — sorry. I'm on my laptop, joining.

ashley: ok I'm checking the runtime metrics. Latency spike started ~12:03 UTC. Looks concentrated in eu-west-1 GPU pool.

ops-sre: seeing continuous 99th p95 jump to ~3.8s on inference-prod-eu. Throughput is normal, but there's a backlog forming on the kv-cache workers.

oncall-runner: IncidentBot auto-created conference bridge (ops-bridge.redwood/8012). Joining.

zach: paging in case secondary can't ack — I'm online. @ashley @maya if you want manager assist for customer comms.

ashley: quick mitigation: scaling dedicated pool + forcing model fallback to quantized-compat to reduce per-token latency. Doing a controlled scale now.

ashley: running scale command:
```
# scale up dedicated pool eu-west-1 by 2 nodes
rwdctl infra pool scale --pool inference-prod-eu --add 2 --reason "latency spike"
# apply fallback profile
rwdctl model set-variant --model redwood/large-v2 --variant quantized-compat --pool inference-prod-eu
```

maya: acked now. After scale start, p50 looks better but p95 still elevated. KV cache miss rate spiked — many cold prefixes after a small deploy at 12:00 UTC.

ashley: WAIT — IncidentBot just fired another escalation to manager even though primary acked. Looks like PagerDuty auto-escalation window wasn't suppressed by ack? pd logs show duplicate escalation event at 12:07.

pagerduty: Alert PD-43321: Escalation attempted: secondary unreachable window. Manager escalation triggered to zach.

zach: got it. That's bad — we're getting duplicate pages because the suppress rule didn't catch the 'ack' event due to an API race. I can mute the escalation policy for 20m while the team stabilizes.

maya: please do, muted now? I can finish cache warm-up script to refill prefixes.

zach: muting escalation policy via pagerduty CLI:
```
pd rules update --policy "hosted-inference-slo" --suppress-for 1200 --reason "manual mute during active mitigation"
```

zach: suppression in place. Confirm no more manager pages expected. If PD still sends, escalate to PD support.

ashley: cache warm-up running: executing prefix prepop job (k=50 parallel)
```
for shard in {1..50}; do rwdctl cache prewarm --pool inference-prod-eu --shard $shard &
done
```

ops-sre: after warm-up, KV miss-rate dropped from 42% -> 6% over 4m. p95 now ~1.6s. Beginning to scale down temporary extra nodes.

oncall-runner: Verified customer-facing traffic: about 620 requests affected with latency >2.5s between 12:03-12:19 UTC. No error responses returned, only slowness. Customer impact tier: degraded performance for small percentage of requests.

ashley: drafting a short customer update — can someone approve? Proposed text:
"We experienced increased inference latency in eu-west-1 between 12:03–12:19 UTC due to a cache-warmup issue after a deploy. The team scaled capacity and warmed caches; no requests failed. We're investigating changes to the deploy path to avoid cache invalidation."

maya: +1. Suggest call out affected endpoints: text-generation and chat-streaming for certain long-context prompts.

zach: approved. Please send once we have final numbers.

ashley: sending now. (sent via status page) https://status.redwood.example/incident/PD-43321

pagerduty: Note: an earlier missed secondary ack caused manager escalation at 12:07. PD investigation ticket opened: TCK-998.

ops-sre: follow-ups: (1) fix PD race where ack wasn't propagated to suppress rules; (2) add prewarm step to deploys in eu-west-1 for models with large kv cache churn; (3) add metric alert for cache-miss rate.

ashley: adding follow-ups to the incident board now and assigning owners.

oncall-runner: Closing notes: Incident resolved at 12:19 UTC. Last alert cleared at 12:34 UTC after cleanup. If PD sent duplicate manager pages, reach out to SRE rotations to confirm no missed pages.

zach: thanks team. We'll do a short postmortem and include the PD race root cause and mitigation plan. Assigning PM for PD suppression fix: @maya.

maya: taking it. Will sync with PD support and ops infra. Filing follow-up ticket: RWD-2211.

ashley: thanks all. :thumbsup:
